FIRST AMENDMENT
to Contract for Security Guards Services
by and between

ZIMS Security (Private) Limited (the "First Party") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited
(the "Second Party")
[Each a "Party' and, collectively, "Parties"]
This first (ist) amendment (the "First Amendment") to the Contract for Security Guards Services
dated 8th February, 2022 (the "Contract") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 29° day of
March, 2024.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Contract for security services to be provided by First Party to
make available Security Staff at the Locations specified by the Second Party on such
terms and conditions as agreed in writing between the Parties from time to time; and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Contract as per the terms and
conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force on 5th February, 2023.

2.

The Term of the Contract is hereby further extended for a period of two (2) years
commencing from 5th February, 2023 and ending on 4th February, 2025 ('Term").

3.

From 15t April, 2024, the rates for security services agreed between the Parties are as
follows:

4.

This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Contract.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Contract shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event
of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in
the Contract shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Contract shall bear the same meaning in
this First Amendment, u

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
